title: Selective telemetry redaction & export fan-out orchestrator
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and implement an orchestrator that applies selective redaction policies at export time when telemetry is fan‑out to downstream analytics systems and third‑party sinks. The orchestrator must enforce configurable retention windows, ensure provable deletion propagation (manifest generation + checkpointed fan‑out), and provide auditability for compliance requests.
acceptance_criteria: Redaction rules evaluate and transform events during export without blocking low-latency writes to primary telemetry store
Deletion manifests are generated per-export with cryptographic attestations and stored for audit
Fan-out jobs are idempotent and support resume/retry semantics with checkpointing
System exposes a queryable audit endpoint that shows deletion status per-export and per-tenant
Backfill run can be run to apply new redaction rules to historical partitions with bounded resource usage
tasks: Design redaction DSL and policy schema
Implement export-stage hooks in console-backend pipeline
Add manifest generator and signer for each export batch
Implement checkpointed fan-out worker with exactly-once semantics
Create end-to-end tests and canary on staging
Document runbook and update retention policy docs
progress_updates: 2025-02-15: Ticket created; initial kickoff with PM and Privacy.
2025-02-18: Chosen redaction DSL: field-level whitelist + regex masks + token hashing. Design doc drafted: https://confluence.company/redwood/console-telemetry-redaction (internal).
2025-02-24: Prototype export hook implemented in staging pipeline; can redact payloads and emit manifest JSON.
2025-02-27: Discovered checkpoint race when worker restarts; changed design to use durable queue and per-batch checkpoints in DynamoDB.
2025-03-04: Integration tests pass for small datasets; working on BigQuery export compliance for schema evolution.
review_comments: PM (Anika Patel): Ensure opt-out telemetry routes remain available for customers during rollout.
Privacy (Liam O'Connor): Manifest must include one-way HMAC and retention policy id for auditability.
Security (Priya Nair): KMS usage required for manifest signing; add key rotation acceptance criteria.
Reviewer (Basir Ali): Confirm performance impact budget; targeted max 5% increase in export tail latency.
notes: Edge case: third-party sinks that require original PII for deduplication — plan for configurable per-sink encryption key escrow and tokenization handshake.
Backfill should run with tenant-level rate limits to avoid cross-tenant blast; plan quota tokens per-tenant.
Consider 'query-time redaction' for sinks that don't support new manifests; add a lightweight proxy that applies policy at read-time.
Future work: UI in Console to preview redaction rules on sample events and request on-demand audit attestations.
